text:
Marina: Sprint-zero sync: propose a small pilot (LangChain + LlamaIndex + Gateway adapters) to validate marketplace packaging, SI runbooks, and quantized runtime behavior. Goal: marketplace listing + co-announcement after pilot.

Evan: I'm game. I'll own an adapter compatibility matrix and a failing-tests harness. ETA for matrix: 2 weeks.

Priya: DevEx will produce a Quickstart + a demo CLI for SI workshops. Also can ship an example notebook and a short video snippet.

Jonah: Partner-eng note: need to test against gateway v1.4 and orch v2.1 in staging. Also require HW vendor guidance on int8/4-bit KV cache edge cases.

Sofia: Product asks: marketplace SKU mapping, a "compatibility badge" criteria, and at least two SI-ready reference flows before public announcement.

Kai: I'll engage Northpoint and Trident as SI pilots and loop in the cloud partner for marketplace procurement path + listing cadence.

Marina: proposed pilot cohort: 3 ISVs, 2 SIs, 1 cloud marketplace slot. Timeline: sprint-zero (discovery) 2w, pilot 4w, review and GA decision 1w.

Evan: For the matrix I'll use columns: `adapter|langchain|llamaindex|gateway_api|orch|quant_mode|sample_case|ci_status|notes`. Will add a severity tag for blockers.

Priya: putting a small shim SDK (compat-lite v0.1) behind feature flag to smooth adapter surface differences. Demo CLI will be under `devex/isv-cli`.

Jonah: HW partners (NVIDIA/AMD/CloudTP) asked for a short compatibility questionnaire. I'll draft and send to them today.

Marina: Action items recorded. Draft playbook link: https://docs.google.com/example-pilot (placeholder)

Marina: Checklist snippet:
```
- Matrix (Evan)
- Quickstart + CLI (Priya)
- Staging tests + HW questionnaire (Jonah)
- SI commitments + GTM contacts (Kai)
- Playbook + announcement plan (Marina)
```

deploy-bot: Heads-up: staging long-run capacity Mon/Wed 10:00-12:00 PT; book via `/deploy schedule` and tag `@eng-sre`.

Sofia: Suggest embargo: 10-day rolling window after GA signoff. We need marketplace legal approval too.

Evan: Tentative dates: matrix by 2026-03-28, Quickstart + CLI by 2026-04-04, staging tests by 2026-04-18, pilot kickoff 2026-04-20.

Priya: DevEx blocker: need a short translatable README for marketplace assets. Will prep a template.

Jonah: blocking item: LlamaIndex 0.6 introduces loader API change. I'll add a compatibility shim test; if it fails we'll pin to 0.5 for pilot.

Kai: I'll confirm SI resource availability and share SOW template.

Marina: I'll consolidate and share a one-pager GTM checklist and request calendar invites for stakeholders. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Kai: +1, thanks.
